slice: reuse a verified company domain before optional search when discovery omits a website
source_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over exact Git blob bytes at source_commit

environment.network: synthetic pages served through a patched public-fetch boundary; no external requests

implemented: For public company discovery without a supplied website, identify an existing company only through the existing resolver and consult only its persisted VERIFIED domain records with approved verification methods and nonempty evidence.

Select among stored verified domains using the original evidence order: first-party job link, existing verified domain, ATS metadata, official career redirect, structured metadata, configured web search, then public metadata.
Ambiguous same-tier domain evidence remains unresolved; a unique verified domain is added to the queued candidate so the bounded public client receives a valid scoped origin.
Connected PERSONAL-mode worker discovery completes from the selected verified domain without invoking the optional search provider; mismatched or unsupported pages retain the existing safety gates.
behavior.remaining: MJ-REQ-060 remains PARTIAL: automatic acquisition across first-party job links, ATS metadata, official redirects/structured metadata, and configured/public providers is not complete across all supported discovery paths.

tests.detail: 42 integration tests passed, including unique verified-domain reuse, first-party evidence precedence, same-tier ambiguity, PERSONAL-mode worker readback, and bounded discovery regressions.
